title: Enrich a Person from an Email Address or a Name and Company
summary: How go-to-market teams and their coding agents turn an email address, or a name and a company, into a full person record with Cargo: reverse email lookup, name-and-company matching, the fields each provider returns, and what a miss costs.
body_markdown:
**To enrich a person for a go-to-market list, pass what you have to one Cargo batch call: an email address goes to` FullEnrich.reverseEmailLookup` ,` apolloio.enrichPerson` or` peopleDataLabs.enrichPerson` , and a name plus a company goes to` apolloio.enrichPerson` ,` peopleDataLabs.enrichPerson` or` linkedin.enrichProfileFromName` .** Each returns the person’s name, title, company and LinkedIn URL, and most providers charge nothing when they find no one.


No Apollo, People Data Labs or FullEnrich account is needed: Cargo calls each provider on its own key and bills credits. If you have a LinkedIn URL instead, skip tothe last section .


## What 1.97M person-enrichment runs show#


Cargo platform data, 90 days to Oct 16 2026: 1.97M person-enrichment runs across 7,810 workspaces, 67.8% of them returned a person, and 89.6% of the runs that found nobody were charged 0 credits.


About one row in three comes back empty, so plan for misses. The cheapest way to cover them is a second provider on the rows the first one missed, not the whole list twice.


## Pick the action by what you have#


You have Action Credits Record


An email (reverse email lookup)` FullEnrich.reverseEmailLookup` 1` {"email":"ada@example.com"}`


An email` apolloio.enrichPerson` 1` {"parameters":{"email":"ada@example.com"}}`


An email` peopleDataLabs.enrichPerson` 3` {"parameters":{"email":"ada@example.com"}}`


A name and a company domain` apolloio.enrichPerson` 1` {"parameters":{"name":"Ada Lovelace","domain":"example.com"}}`


A name and a company` peopleDataLabs.enrichPerson` 3` {"parameters":{"name":"Ada Lovelace","company":"Example"}}`


A name and a company` linkedin.enrichProfileFromName` 0.5` {"name":"Ada Lovelace","companyName":"Example"}`


An email, or a name and domain` enrichCrm.enrichPerson` 1` {"email":"ada@example.com"}`


Prices are each action’s list price per call. Three details change how you use them:


- **A miss is free on all of them but one.** Apollo, People Data Labs, FullEnrich, the LinkedIn action and RocketReach return no data when they find no one, and no credits are charged.` enrichCrm.enrichPerson` charges its 1 credit per call, found or not.
- **Apollo with phone costs more.** Setting` "revealPhoneNumber": true` on` apolloio.enrichPerson` moves it from 1 to 9 credits and waits for Apollo to deliver the number.
- **Reverse email lookup is asynchronous.**` FullEnrich.reverseEmailLookup` starts a lookup and waits for FullEnrich to call back, so a batch can take minutes.` --wait-until-finished` handles the wait.


` enrichCrm.enrichPerson` takes an` email` , or a` domainName` with` firstName` and` lastName` , or a` domainName` with` fullName` .` rocketreach.lookupPerson` (1 credit) takes an` email` or a` linkedinUrl` .


## Run it#


### 1. Install and sign in


shellscript


```text
npm   install   -g   @cargo-ai/cli
cargo-ai   login   --email   you@company.com                   # sends a code
cargo-ai   login   --email   you@company.com   --code   123456     # creates the account on first use


```


There is no browser step, so a coding agent can run this itself. A new account starts with 100 free credits and no card.


### 2. Find the actions


shellscript


```text
cargo-ai   orchestration   action   list   enrich   person   --kind   connector


```


Each result carries the` action` object the next command takes and a` credits` array with its price. Nothing runs and nothing is charged.


### 3. Pilot on 5 rows


shellscript


```text
cargo-ai   orchestration   action   execute-batch   \
--action   '{"kind":"connector","integrationSlug":"apolloio","actionSlug":"enrichPerson"}'   \
--records   '[{"parameters":{"email":"ada@example.com"}},{"parameters":{"name":"Grace Hopper","domain":"example.org"}}]'   \
--limit   5   --wait-until-finished


```


` --limit 5` submits only the first five records, so you can read the output and the cost before the full run. Apollo’s` name` field is a first and last name separated by a space; use it instead of` first_name` and` last_name` , not alongside them.


### 4. Run the list, then send only the misses on


Drop` --limit` to run every row, then download the results:


shellscript


```text
cargo-ai   orchestration   batch   download   --uuid   <  batch-uui  d  >


```


Keep the rows that came back without a person and send those to the next provider. For a reverse email lookup:


shellscript


```text
cargo-ai   orchestration   action   execute-batch   \
--action   '{"kind":"connector","integrationSlug":"FullEnrich","actionSlug":"reverseEmailLookup"}'   \
--records   "$(  cat   misses.json)"   \
--wait-until-finished


```


Never send the full list to a second provider: the people already found are paid for, and the second provider charges again for them.


## What comes back#


Action Name Title and company LinkedIn URL


` apolloio.enrichPerson`` person.name`` person.title` ,` person.organization.name` ,` .primary_domain`` person.linkedin_url`


` peopleDataLabs.enrichPerson`` full_name`` job_title` ,` job_company_name` ,` job_company_website`` linkedin_url`


` FullEnrich.reverseEmailLookup`` firstname` ,` lastname`` profile.position.title` ,` profile.position.company.name` ,` .domain`` profile.linkedin_url`


` linkedin.enrichProfileFromName`` full_name`` job_title` ,` company` ,` company_domain`` linkedin_url`


` enrichCrm.enrichPerson`` name`` headline` ,` activeCompany`` linkedInUrl`


Apollo also returns` person.email` and` person.email_status` , and People Data Labs returns` work_email` and` location_name` when it has them.` cargo-ai orchestration action get-output-schema --action '<action object>'` prints any action’s full output schema without running it.


## If you already have a LinkedIn URL#


A LinkedIn URL is the strongest key a person has, and two actions take it directly:


- ` aiArk.enrichPerson` (0.1 credits) takes` {"linkedinUrl":"..."}` , returns the profile with a found email, and charges nothing when it finds no email.
- ` contactOut.enrich` takes` {"objectType":"contact","linkedinUrl":"...","includePhone":false,"emailType":\[\]}` at 1 credit. Asking for emails (` "emailType":\["work"\]` ) costs 2, and` "includePhone":true` costs 3.


To get the URL from a name and company first, use the[find-linkedin-url](https://www.getcargo.ai/skills/find-linkedin-url) skill; to read the full profile from it,[enrich-linkedin-profile](https://www.getcargo.ai/skills/enrich-linkedin-profile) . Once a record has a work email,[find and verify work emails at scale](https://www.getcargo.ai/blog/find-and-verify-work-emails-at-scale) covers checking it before a send, and[waterfall enrichment](https://www.getcargo.ai/blog/waterfall-enrichment-the-secret-sauce-to-maximize-enrichment-coverage) covers chaining providers in general.
